name: repository-bootstrap
description: Developer setup of the repository itself: git submodule retrieval, lib/vestigium build ordering, and npm dependency installation for server / frontend / packages. Runtime behaviour is out of scope.
cardTemplate: Summarise the "repository-bootstrap" domain: Developer setup of the repository itself — submodule retrieval, lib/vestigium build ordering, and npm dependency installation.
specRefs: README.md 依存インストール
rationale: server depends on lib/vestigium through file:, and that submodule is empty in a fresh clone or worktree. The ordering that makes the repository buildable is a concern of its own, separate from any runtime domain, so the scripts that encode it get their own domain instead of being attached to configuration-secrets.
